edges.rationale: Application requirements establish the criteria (latency, accuracy, cost, privacy) needed to determine which model capabilities are relevant for comparison.
Application requirements define which tasks and metrics are relevant for evaluating model performance.
Model capabilities comparison identifies candidate models and their characteristics, which informs which specific models should be evaluated for performance on target tasks.
Performance evaluation results are needed to assess whether a model meets application requirements before analyzing its cost and deployment implications.
Application requirements such as cost constraints and privacy needs directly inform the trade-off analysis between proprietary APIs and self-hosted models.
